usage: The word 'soeng5 nin4' is a noun referring to the year before the current year.
It is commonly used to talk about events or experiences that happened last year.
You can use 'soeng5 nin4' without a classifier when referring generally to last year.
It often appears in sentences to specify the time frame of past actions or situations.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng5 nin4 heoi3 zo2 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.meaning: I went to Japan last year.

examples.jyutping: soeng5 nin4 tin1 hei3 hou2 jit6.
examples.meaning: Last year the weather was very hot.

examples.jyutping: keoi5 soeng5 nin4 hoi1 ci2 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.meaning: He/she started learning Cantonese last year.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng5 nin4 wun6 zo2 fan6 san1 gung1.
examples.meaning: I changed to a new job last year.

related: 前年 (cin4 nin4) - year before last
